The lesson for Formal AI: the\n  self-coding loop does not need a finished toolbox up front; it needs a\n  reliable start-to-end loop plus the ability to extend itself mid-run,\n  which is exactly the gap the PhU3X2/8GWnaH logs expose (R1b).\n- [OpenHands](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands) (MIT-licensed,\n  ex-OpenDevin) executes plans as code actions in a sandboxed Docker\n  environment and iterates on test results — the same\n  execute-verify-iterate contract CONTRIBUTING.md already mandates for the\n  in-repo agentic driver.\n- [SWE-agent](https://github.com/SWE-agent/SWE-agent) introduced the\n  Agent-Computer Interface: a small, stable command surface an agent can\n  reliably drive. Formal AI's OpenAI-compatible `serve` boundary plus the\n  external `@link-assistant/agent` CLI is this project's ACI; keeping it\n  small and deterministic is what makes symbolic self-coding testable.\n- [SWE-EVO (arXiv:2512.18470)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2512.18470) and\n  [SWE-Chain (arXiv:2605.14415)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.14415)\n  benchmark long-horizon, multi-step evolution — evidence that \"one issue,\n  one PR, every requirement\" (R11) is measured industry-wide as chained\n  end-to-end completion, not single-patch success.\n\n## Upstream reports and new-component proposals (R5, R6)\n\n### Upstream (R5)\n\n- **`link-assistant/agent` — fail-open model substitution (Defect A).**\n  Reported upstream (link added to PR #997 once filed): when `--model` is\n  present in `process.argv` but argument parsing fails (Bun/yargs,\n  oven-sh/bun#22157), the CLI logs CRITICAL and continues with the default\n  model. Already tracked in the companion issue's\n  thread; no new issue needed.\n\n### New-component proposals (R6)\n\n- **Routing-trace contract.** `trace_route` currently emits ad-hoc\n  `[trace] route=value` lines. Not needed yet —\n  two call sites do not justify a component.\n- **No missing external library was identified.** The gaps found in this\n  case study are contract gaps (fail-fast, fencing, routing coverage), all\n  addressable inside the existing stack; introducing a new dependency would\n  specialize rather than generalize.\n",

The lesson for Formal AI: the\n  self-coding loop does not need a finished toolbox up front; it needs a\n  reliable start-to-end loop plus the ability to extend itself mid-run,\n  which is exactly the gap the PhU3X2/8GWnaH logs expose (R1b).\n- [OpenHands](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands) (MIT-licensed,\n  ex-OpenDevin) executes plans as code actions in a sandboxed Docker\n  environment and iterates on test results — the same\n  execute-verify-iterate contract CONTRIBUTING.md already mandates for the\n  in-repo agentic driver.\n- [SWE-agent](https://github.com/SWE-agent/SWE-agent) introduced the\n  Agent-Computer Interface: a small, stable command surface an agent can\n  reliably drive. Formal AI's OpenAI-compatible `serve` boundary plus the\n  external `@link-assistant/agent` CLI is this project's ACI; keeping it\n  small and deterministic is what makes symbolic self-coding testable.\n- [SWE-EVO (arXiv:2512.18470)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2512.18470) and\n  [SWE-Chain (arXiv:2605.14415)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.14415)\n  benchmark long-horizon, multi-step evolution — evidence that \"one issue,\n  one PR, every requirement\" (R11) is measured industry-wide as chained\n  end-to-end completion, not single-patch success.\n\n## Upstream reports and new-component proposals (R5, R6)\n\n### Upstream (R5)\n\n- **`link-assistant/agent` — fail-open model substitution (Defect A).**\n  Reported upstream as\n  [agent#293](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/issues/293), fixed by\n  [agent PR #294](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/pull/294)\n  (released in `js-0.25.8`): an unparseable `--model` (Bun/yargs,\n  oven-sh/bun#22157) now fails closed instead of silently continuing on the\n  default model. Not needed yet —\n  two call sites do not justify a component.\n- **No missing external library was identified.** The gaps found in this\n  case study are contract gaps (fail-fast, fencing, routing coverage), all\n  addressable inside the existing stack; introducing a new dependency would\n  specialize rather than generalize.\n",

| Issue | Fix | Test |
| --- | --- | --- |
| #956 | A formalization task that quotes its own source text («…», “…”, 「…」, 《…》) now formalizes that text instead of silently substituting the seeded «Сказка о рыбаке и рыбке» tale; a quoted *title* of the tale still selects the full canonical text. `FORMAL_AI_TRACE_REQUESTS=1` now also traces `agentic_task` / `formalization_source` routing. The recipe moved to `src/agentic_coding/formalization_recipe.rs` (file-size gate). | `tests/unit/issue_956.rs` (4 tests, en/ru/zh/hi) |
| #945 | `Report`-flow harness/server log exports go to a surviving temp directory that prints its path, instead of dropping `formal-ai-*.lino` dumps into the caller's working directory. Also fixes machine-value report-target matching (`formal_ai` was dropped by prompt normalization). | `tests/unit/issue_945.rs` |
| #979 | The Russian liveness probes «Ты тут?», «вы тут», «я тут» route to the `test_status` intent instead of falling through to a web search (pure seed data: `data/seed/intent-routing.lino`). Bare «тест», reported against v0.333.1, already routes correctly on current `main`. | `tests/unit/test_status.rs` extended matrix |

| hive-mind #2146 (R1c) | Final answers that inline machine text (general-change plan event, formalized knowledge base) wrap it in fenced `lino` code blocks so GitHub comments render it correctly. | `tests/unit/issue_996_markdown.rs` (3 tests) |

## Hive Mind session-log analysis (hive-mind #2146)

Three sanitized `solve` session logs are preserved under `docs/case-studies/issue-996/raw-data/` and analyzed line-by-line in the case study:

- **Defect A — silent model substitution**: the `XOq3KX` session requested `--model formalai/formal-ai` but ran on `minimax-m2.5-free` (Bun/yargs argv bug, fail-open). Already reported and fixed upstream fail-closed in [agent#293](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/issues/293) / [PR #294](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/pull/294) (`js-0.25.8`); the machine-readable `model_resolved` attestation follow-up is [agent#295](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/issues/295).
- **Defect B — empty runs triggering auto-restart**: the `PhU3X2`/`8GWnaH` sessions ended with conversational filler and zero code changes. Formal-AI-side legs fixed here (#956 routing + routing trace); the restart-budget leg is Hive-Mind-side (R-B3 in hive-mind #2146).
- **Defect C — collapsed markdown**: fixed by the fenced-block change above.

## Not closed here, with recorded plans

- #943 (unrequested issue filing): analyzed; the fix needs a negation lexicon in the seed plus a refusal path mirroring `protocol_policy.rs` — plan recorded in the case study so the issue can proceed independently.

[2026-08-11T00:45:01.427Z] [INFO]    - When you see screenshots or images in issue descriptions, pull request descriptions, comments, or discussions, download the image to a local file first, then use the Read tool to view and analyze it. Before reading downloaded images with the Read tool, verify that the file is a valid image rather than HTML by using a CLI tool such as the 'file' command. When corrupted or non-image files, such as GitHub "Not Found" pages saved as `.png`, are read, they can cause "Could not process image" errors and crash the AI solver process. When the file command shows "HTML", "text", or "ASCII text", the download failed, so do not call Read on that file. Instead: (1) when images are from GitHub issues or PRs, such as URLs containing "github.com/user-attachments", retry with: curl -L -H "Authorization: [REDACTED] $(gh auth token)" -o <filename> "<url>" (2) when the retry still fails, skip the image and note that it was unavailable.
